modalLead: A fix on top of v2026.09.09. Recorded here but not announced: v2026.09.09 is the release worth reading, and this does not displace it.

items.text: Opening a bookmark from Health no longer claims its category was deleted. The jump waited a fixed two frames for the grid and then gave up, which was long enough on a small collection and not on a real one — so it reported a category that was sitting in plain sight on the same page. It now waits until the row is actually there.
